policies.name: body-only
policies.description: Count core and assimilated energy; exclude gut, carried terrain, and in-flight escrow

policies.name: gut-quarter
policies.description: Count gut contents at 25 percent and exclude carried terrain and escrow

policies.name: gut-half
policies.description: Count gut contents at 50 percent and exclude carried terrain and escrow

policies.name: gut-full
policies.description: Count all cell core, assimilated, and gut energy; exclude carried terrain and escrow

policies.name: all-cell-compartments
policies.description: Count every cell-owned compartment, including carried terrain and pending payload escrow

policies.name: body-only-margin-10
policies.description: Body-only score must lead by at least ten mass-energy units; smaller leads remain draws
